gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-alumni-s: Expressive and low-slung, Love Ya Like A Sister barely lifts its ascenders. The heading does its best work with bold, level declarations, while Alumni Sans Pinstripe does its best with tight word texture and oversized lowercase.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-farro: Ascenders barely clear the x-height in Love Ya Like A Sister, giving it a low, bold stance. And Farro, compressed in its ascenders and utterly free of stroke contrast, gives that boldness a sturdy partner.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-krona-on: Low, level and loud: Love Ya Like A Sister never tapers a stroke. Krona One brings loosely spaced letters and cast-iron stature to the lowercase, a sturdy partner for that blunt-ended heading.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-mitr: Flat, contrast-free and low-slung, Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders barely above the x-height and its beat quiet. Mitr settles into a contemporary, compact rhythm, its lowercase nearly capital height.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-mukta: Monoline and low-slung, Love Ya Like A Sister swaggers boldly, its terminal tips pointing outward. Mukta, with tall-bodied small letters, gives that low, level heading a lofty, clean counterweight.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-mukta-ma: Mukta Malar keeps its ascenders compressed and its manner approachable, a quiet foil for the bolder heading. Mukta Malar then lets Love Ya Like A Sister take the spotlight, its flat, swell-free downstrokes setting the tone.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-mukta-va: Cut-ribbon strokes, low and bold: Love Ya Like A Sister holds its width from start to finish. Yet Mukta Vaani, with its high-waisted lowercase, gives that heading a contemporary, understated partner.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-narnoor: Expressive and stencil-cut, Love Ya Like A Sister cuts each stroke at a constant weight. Narnoor, with short ascenders above big bowls, makes extended reading feel steady and businesslike.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-port-lli: Love Ya Like A Sister writes with a drafting pen's steady line. Port Lligat Sans reads modern and quiet, its characters packed close and its bowls unfinished on one side, so lines move along briskly.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-rambla: Love Ya Like A Sister writes every stroke with one fixed nib. Rambla brings lowercase that rises nearly to capital height, a steady stance that holds the bolder heading firmly in place.
